title: Fernwood - how does she change places?  (414 x A+, with 'Midtown condo' as the placeholder second estate)
decision: At two grants, what is the switch - and what does she see at ONE grant?
criteria: Navigation not a question | absent at one grant | never gates the glance | a change action not an entry action
recommend: R1-SA: the control is the display. It costs one glyph, and at one grant it is simply absent rather than disabled.

exhibits.label: no selector (today)
exhibits.note: One grant, so nothing to switch. This is what she sees until the condo exists.
exhibits.look: The masthead already names the place in the largest type in the product.

exhibits.label: the masthead IS the control
exhibits.note: The h1 block becomes tappable and gains one chevron. Nothing else is added.
exhibits.look: One new glyph, zero new pixels of height. The thing that names the place is the thing you tap.

exhibits.label: a switch row
exhibits.note: Two place chips above the jump strip.
exhibits.look: It reads as PART of the jump strip - competing with the one affordance she takes 5 of 5 times.

exhibits.label: a picker screen
exhibits.note: A full screen listing both places, before the app.
exhibits.look: A whole screen spent on a BINARY she changes about twice a year.
